Product Details: 150 PSI High-Performance Motor for Rapid Inflation: The Portronics Vayu 5.0 Lite delivers powerful air output capable of inflating a completely flat car tyre in just a few minutes. Whether you are topping up a slightly deflated tyre or dealing with an emergency flat, this inflator ensures you get back on the road quickly and safely. 12V DC Corded Convenience for Continuous Power: No need to worry about battery levels — simply plug the inflator into your car’s 12V cigarette lighter socket and enjoy uninterrupted operation. Perfect for long drives, road trips, and emergency situations where reliability matters most. LED Digital Display for Accurate Readings: The bright digital display clearly shows the current tyre pressure in real time, allowing you to monitor the inflation process with precision. This ensures that every tyre is inflated to the recommended PSI, improving safety, fuel efficiency, and tyre lifespan. The easy-to-read screen makes it simple for anyone — even first-time users — to get professional-level accuracy without guesswork. Extra-Long 3-Meter Power Cord for Easy Reach: Designed for practicality, the 3-meter cord allows you to comfortably reach all four tyres from a single power point. Ideal for larger vehicles like SUVs and sedans where mobility is limited. Smart Pressure Detection for Accurate Inflation: Built-in pressure monitoring technology detects and maintains the desired air pressure, preventing over-inflation that can damage tyres. This feature helps maintain correct PSI levels for better fuel efficiency, improved handling, and longer tyre life. Integrated LED Light for Night-Time Emergencies: The bright LED light illuminates the work area, making tyre inflation quick and safe even in low-light conditions. A must-have feature for night drives, highway travel, or dimly lit parking areas. Compact & Portable Travel Companion: Measuring just 19 x 10 x 5.4 cm and weighing only 540 grams, this tyre inflator is designed for portability. It easily fits into your glovebox, under-seat storage, or backpack, making it convenient to carry wherever you go. Versatile Multi-Use with Included Nozzles: Comes with 4 multifunctional nozzles, enabling you to inflate not just car tyres but also bike tyres, cycle tyres, footballs, basketballs, and other inflatables — making it a true all-in-one air solution for your home or travel kit.
